templates.pat: {{1}}{{2}} The order of subtracks in the {{3}} section determines the display position on the main Genome Browser display page. Tracks can be sorted by clicking on the attribute links at the top of the column (if any). The arrows next to the attribute links indicate which direction the columns are being sorted. The numbers next to the arrows indicate the priority of the sort for each attribute. Additionally, some subtracks can be ordered by "drag and drop": click and hold a subtrack checkbox in the {{4}} section and release it in a new position. Note that tracks may be reordered by "drag and drop" in the main Genome Browser display. Those changes will not be reflected in this list.

templates.zh: 在 BLAT 中使用任意 {{1}} 选项（如 {{2}}）都能加快检索，效果类似重复序列屏蔽。{{3}} 文件收录的是判定为在基因组序列中过度代表的序列。为提升检索速度，用这些序列对基因组建立比对种子时不予使用。对于长度合理的序列，这不会造成问题，并能明显缩短处理时间。

templates.pat: By not using the {{1}} file, you will increase alignment time, but will also slightly increase sensitivity. This may be important if you are aligning shorter sequences or sequences of poor quality. For example, if a particular sequence consists primarily of sequences in the {{2}} file, it will never be seeded correctly for an alignment if the {{3}} flag is used.
templates.zh: 不使用 {{1}} 文件会增加比对时间，但灵敏度也会略有提高。这在比对较短或质量较差的序列时可能很重要。例如，若某段序列主要由 {{2}} 文件中的序列构成，使用 {{3}} 选项时就永远无法正确建立比对种子。

templates.pat: In summary, if you are not finding certain sequences and can afford the extra processing time, you may want to run BLAT without the {{1}} file if your particular situation warrants its use.
templates.zh: 总之，如果某些序列找不到，而且你能接受额外的处理时间，在具体情形允许时可以不使用 {{1}} 文件来运行 BLAT。

templates.zh: 查看源码树中的 perl 脚本：{{1}}

templates.zh: 查看对应的 C 程序：{{1}}，以及 {{4}} 中相关的库函数 {{2}} 与 {{3}}

See the section on {{2}} for information on calculating the score.
templates.zh: 要复现涉及评分的任一排序选项，先要算出 PSL 输出文件中每条结果的评分，再按评分或其他组合排序（{{1}}「query, score」与「chrom, score」）。评分的计算方法见{{2}}一节。

templates.pat: Use a large value for {{1}} (e.g. {{2}} = 1000000) to reduce the chance of a tile being marked as over-used.
templates.zh: 把 {{1}} 设得很大（例如 {{2}} = 1000000），可降低某个 tile 被标记为过度使用的概率。

templates.pat: Do not use an {{1}} file.
templates.zh: 不要使用 {{1}} 文件。

templates.pat: {{1}} - The name of the chromosome (e.g. chr3, chrY, chr2_random) or scaffold (e.g. scaffold10671). Many assemblies also support several different {{2}} (e.g. '1' or 'NC_000001.11' in place of 'chr1').
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 染色体名称（如 chr3、chrY、chr2_random）或 scaffold 名称（如 scaffold10671）。许多组装还支持多种{{2}}（例如用 '1' 或 'NC_000001.11' 代替 'chr1'）。

templates.pat: {{1}} - The starting position of the feature in the chromosome or scaffold. The first base in a chromosome is numbered 0.
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 特征在染色体或 scaffold 上的起始位置。染色体第一个碱基的编号为 0。

templates.pat: {{1}} - The ending position of the feature in the chromosome or scaffold. The {{2}} base is not included in the display of the feature, however, the number in {{3}} will be represented. For example, the first 100 bases of chromosome 1 are defined as {{4}}, and span the bases numbered 0-99 in our software (not 0-100), but will represent the position notation chr1:1-100. Read more {{5}}. {{6}}{{7}} and {{8}} can be identical, creating a feature of length 0, commonly used for insertions. For example, use {{9}} to represent an insertion before the first nucleotide of a chromosome.
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 特征在染色体或 scaffold 上的结束位置。{{2}} 这个碱基不计入特征显示范围，但 {{3}} 中的数字仍会体现。例如染色体 1 的前 100 个碱基写作 {{4}}，在我们的软件里覆盖编号 0–99 的碱基（不是 0–100），但位置记法为 chr1:1-100。更多说明见{{5}}。{{6}}{{7}} 与 {{8}} 可以相同，从而生成长度为 0 的特征，常用于表示插入。例如用 {{9}} 表示染色体第一个核苷酸之前的插入。

templates.pat: {{1}} - Defines the name of the BED line. This label is displayed to the left of the BED line in the Genome Browser window when the track is open to full display mode or directly to the left of the item in pack mode.
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 定义 BED 行的名称。轨道处于 full 显示模式时，该标签显示在基因组浏览器窗口中 BED 行的左侧；pack 模式下则直接显示在条目左侧。

templates.pat: {{1}} - Defines the strand. Either "." (=no strand) or "+" or "-".

{{1}} - The starting position at which the feature is drawn thickly (for example, the start codon in gene displays). When there is no thick part, thickStart and thickEnd are usually set to the chromStart position.
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 特征被画成粗线的起始位置（例如基因显示中的起始密码子）。没有粗线部分时，thickStart 与 thickEnd 通常设为 chromStart 的位置。

templates.pat: {{1}} - The ending position at which the feature is drawn thickly (for example the stop codon in gene displays).
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 特征被画成粗线的结束位置（例如基因显示中的终止密码子）。

templates.pat: {{1}} - An RGB value of the form R,G,B (e.g. 255,0,0). If the track line {{2}} attribute is set to "On", this RGB value will determine the display color of the data contained in this BED line. NOTE: It is recommended that a simple color scheme (eight colors or less) be used with this attribute to avoid overwhelming the color resources of the Genome Browser and your Internet browser.
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 形如 R,G,B 的 RGB 值（如 255,0,0）。若轨道行的 {{2}} 属性设为「On」，该 RGB 值决定这一 BED 行数据的显示颜色。注意：建议只用简单配色（八种颜色以内），以免耗尽基因组浏览器与你的浏览器可用的颜色资源。

templates.pat: {{1}} - The number of blocks (exons) in the BED line.
templates.zh: {{1}} —— BED 行中的区块（外显子）数量。

templates.pat: {{1}} - A comma-separated list of the block sizes. The number of items in this list should correspond to {{2}}.
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 以逗号分隔的区块大小列表。列表项数应与 {{2}} 对应。

templates.pat: {{1}} - A comma-separated list of block starts. All of the {{2}} positions should be calculated relative to {{3}}. The number of items in this list should correspond to {{4}}.
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 以逗号分隔的区块起始位置列表。所有 {{2}} 位置都应相对于 {{3}} 计算。列表项数应与 {{4}} 对应。

templates.pat: In BED files with block definitions, the first {{1}} value must be 0, so that the first block begins at {{2}}. Similarly, the final {{3}} position plus the final {{4}} value must equal {{5}}. Blocks may not overlap.
templates.zh: 在带区块定义的 BED 文件中，第一个 {{1}} 值必须为 0，这样第一个区块才从 {{2}} 开始。同理，最后的 {{3}} 位置加上最后的 {{4}} 值必须等于 {{5}}。区块之间不得重叠。

templates.pat: PSL lines represent alignments, and are typically taken from files generated by BLAT or psLayout. See the {{1}} for more details. PSL data tracks can also be visualized in {{2}}. All of the following fields are required on each data line within a PSL file:
templates.zh: PSL 行表示比对结果，通常来自 BLAT 或 psLayout 生成的文件。更多说明见{{1}}。PSL 数据轨道也可以用{{2}}可视化。PSL 文件每条数据行都必须包含以下全部字段：

templates.pat: {{1}} - Number of bases that match that aren't repeats
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 匹配且不属于重复序列的碱基数

templates.pat: {{1}} - Number of bases that don't match
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 不匹配的碱基数

templates.pat: {{1}} - Number of bases that match but are part of repeats
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 匹配但属于重复序列的碱基数

templates.pat: {{1}} - Number of "N" bases
{{1}} - Number of inserts in query
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 查询序列中的插入片段数

templates.pat: {{1}} - Number of bases inserted in query
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 查询序列中插入的碱基数

templates.pat: {{1}} - Number of inserts in target
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 目标序列中的插入片段数

templates.pat: {{1}} - Number of bases inserted in target
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 目标序列中插入的碱基数

templates.pat: {{1}} - "+" or "-" for query strand. For translated alignments, second "+"or "-" is for target genomic strand.
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 查询链，取 "+" 或 "-"。翻译比对时，第二个 "+" 或 "-" 表示目标基因组链。

templates.pat: {{1}} - Query sequence name
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 查询序列名称

templates.pat: {{1}} - Query sequence size.
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 查询序列长度。

templates.pat: {{1}} - Alignment start position in query
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 比对在查询序列中的起始位置

templates.pat: {{1}} - Alignment end position in query
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 比对在查询序列中的结束位置

templates.pat: {{1}} - Target sequence name
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 目标序列名称

templates.pat: {{1}} - Target sequence size
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 目标序列长度

templates.pat: {{1}} - Alignment start position in target
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 比对在目标序列中的起始位置

templates.pat: {{1}} - Alignment end position in target
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 比对在目标序列中的结束位置

templates.pat: {{1}} - Number of blocks in the alignment (a block contains no gaps)
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 比对中的区块数（区块内不含空位）

templates.pat: {{1}} - Comma-separated list of sizes of each block. If the query is a protein and the target the genome, blockSizes are in amino acids. See below for more information on protein query PSLs.
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 以逗号分隔的各区块大小列表。若查询是蛋白质、目标是基因组，blockSizes 以氨基酸为单位。蛋白质查询 PSL 的更多说明见下文。

templates.pat: {{1}} - Comma-separated list of starting positions of each block in query
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 以逗号分隔的各区块在查询序列中的起始位置

templates.pat: {{1}} - Comma-separated list of starting positions of each block in target
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 以逗号分隔的各区块在目标序列中的起始位置

templates.pat: Visit our {{1}} for more videos.
templates.zh: 观看更多视频，请访问我们的{{1}}。

templates.zh: 轨道数据可用{{1}}以文本表格形式查看。

templates.zh: 表格浏览器各项功能的用法，请参阅{{1}}。

templates.zh: 会话工具的详细用法，请参阅{{1}}。

templates.zh: {{1}} {{2}} 单击{{3}}按钮后，出现错误信息「line 1 of custom input:」。

templates.zh: {{1}} {{2}} 定义随该轨道显示的 HTML 说明页 URL。该属性没有默认值。标准格式 HTML 轨道说明的模板见 {{3}}。

templates.pat: {{1}} - a tool that allows you to upload and display genome-wide data sets such as the results of genome-wide SNP association studies, linkage studies and homozygosity mapping. {{2}}.
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 一个可上传并显示全基因组数据集的工具，例如全基因组 SNP 关联研究、连锁研究与纯合性定位的结果。{{2}}。

templates.zh: {{1}} 不建议用 LiftOver 在不同组装之间转换 SNP；关于如何转换的更多说明见下面的{{2}}。

Data provided by a URL may need to be proceeded by a separate line defining {{1}} required for some tracks, for example such as "track type=broadPeak". {{2}} {{3}}

templates.pat: The output file {{1}} should have results very similar to web-based Blat.
templates.zh: 输出文件 {{1}} 的结果应与网页版 Blat 非常接近。

templates.pat: Once you have the downloaded the {{1}} program to your computer, ensure the 'execute' bit is on for permissions:
templates.zh: 把 {{1}} 程序下载到本机后，确认权限里已打开「执行」位：

templates.pat: If the permissions indicate something like: {{1}}, then you will need to enable the ability to execute the program:
templates.zh: 若权限显示类似 {{1}}，则需要开启程序的可执行权限：

templates.pat: If you have access to a Linux or Mac OSX command-line you can run {{1}} locally. The blat binary is available under the directory for your system type under the {{2}} on our download server.
templates.zh: 如果你有 Linux 或 Mac OSX 命令行，可以在本地运行 {{1}}。blat 可执行文件放在我们下载服务器上 {{2}} 中对应你系统类型的目录下。

templates.pat: If the {{1}} is changed to {{2}} on web Blat, the same zero-based half open coordinate results will be seen as the standalone Blat and gfServer/gfClient procedures.
templates.zh: 若在网页版 Blat 中把 {{1}} 改为 {{2}}，得到的结果与独立版 Blat 及 gfServer/gfClient 流程一致，都是零基半开区间坐标。

templates.pat: This usually occurs on the newer genome assemblies, such as hg38, when you search a sequence that has an "alternate" or "fix" sequence. To improve the quality of these assemblies, curators have added multiple versions of some important loci, e.g. the MHC regions. They also add fix sequences to resolve errors without changing the reference. See our {{1}} for more information.
templates.zh: 这种情况通常出现在较新的基因组组装（如 hg38）中，当你检索的序列存在「alternate」或「fix」序列时就会发生。为提高这些组装的质量，策展人员为某些重要位点（例如 MHC 区域）加入了多个版本，也会加入 fix 序列以在不改变参考序列的前提下修正错误。更多说明见{{1}}。

templates.pat: GFF (General Feature Format) lines are based on the Sanger {{1}}. GFF lines have nine required fields that {{2}} be tab-separated. If the fields are separated by spaces instead of tabs, the track will not display correctly. For more information on GFF format, refer to Sanger's {{3}}.
templates.zh: GFF（General Feature Format）行基于 Sanger 的{{1}}。GFF 行有九个必填字段，{{2}} 以制表符分隔。若字段之间用空格而非制表符分隔，轨道将无法正确显示。GFF 格式的更多说明见 Sanger 的{{3}}。

templates.pat: {{1}} - The name of the sequence. Must be a chromosome or scaffold.
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 序列名称。必须是染色体或 scaffold。

templates.pat: {{1}} - The program that generated this feature.
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 生成该特征的程序。

templates.pat: {{1}} - The name of this type of feature. Some examples of standard feature types are "CDS" "start_codon" "stop_codon" and "exon".
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 该特征类型的名称。标准特征类型的例子有 "CDS"、"start_codon"、"stop_codon" 与 "exon"。

templates.pat: {{1}} - The starting position of the feature in the sequence. The first base is numbered 1.
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 特征在序列中的起始位置。第一个碱基编号为 1。

templates.pat: {{1}} - The ending position of the feature (inclusive).
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 特征的结束位置（含该位置）。

templates.pat: {{1}} - A score between 0 and 1000. If the track line {{2}} attribute is set to 1 for this annotation data set, the {{3}} value will determine the level of gray in which this feature is displayed (higher numbers = darker gray). If there is no score value, enter ".".
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 0 到 1000 的分数。若该注释数据集的轨道行 {{2}} 属性设为 1，则 {{3}} 值决定该特征显示的灰度（数值越大越深）。没有分值时填 "."。

templates.pat: {{1}} - Valid entries include "+", "-", or "." (for don't know/don't care).
{{1}} - If the feature is a coding exon, {{2}} should be a number between 0-2 that represents the reading frame of the first base. If the feature is not a coding exon, the value should be ".".
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 若该特征是编码外显子，{{2}} 应为 0–2 之间的数字，表示第一个碱基的阅读框。若该特征不是编码外显子，值应为 "."。

templates.pat: {{1}} - All lines with the same group are linked together into a single item.
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 同一 group 的所有行会连成一个条目。

templates.pat: BED information should not be mixed as explained above (BED3 should not be mixed with BED4), rather additional column information must be filled for consistency, for example with a "." in some circumstances, if the field content is to be empty. BED fields in custom tracks can be whitespace-delimited or tab-delimited. Only some variations of BED types, such as {{1}}, require a tab character delimitation for the detail columns.
templates.zh: BED 信息不应如上面解释的那样混用（BED3 不应与 BED4 混用），而应为保持一致补齐额外的列信息，例如在字段内容为空时视情况填入“.”。自定义轨道中的 BED 字段可以用空白分隔，也可以用制表符分隔。只有某些 BED 变体（如 {{1}}）才要求详情列用制表符分隔。

templates.pat: If your data set is BED-like, but it is very large (over 50MB) and you would like to keep it on your own server, you should use the {{1}} data format. Read a {{2}} for step-by-step instructions.
templates.zh: 如果你的数据集是类 BED 格式，但体积很大（超过 50MB）且希望保留在自己的服务器上，就应使用 {{1}} 数据格式。阅读{{2}}获取分步说明。

templates.pat: {{1}} - A score between 0 and 1000. templates.pat: Be aware that the coordinates for a negative strand in a dna query PSL line are handled in a special way. In the {{1}} and {{2}} fields, the coordinates indicate the position where the query matches from the point of view of the forward strand, even when the match is on the reverse strand. templates.pat: {{1}}{{2}} A protein query consists of amino acids. To align amino acids against a database of nucleic acids, each target chromosome is first translated into amino acids for each of the six different reading frames. The resulting protein PSL is a hybrid; the query fields are all in amino acid coordinates and sizes, while the target database fields are in nucleic acid chromosome coordinates and sizes. The fields shared by query and target are blockCount and blockSizes. But blockSizes differ between query (AA) and target (NA), so a single field cannot represent both. A choice was therefore made to report the blockSizes field in amino acids since it is a protein query.

templates.pat: HAL is a graph-based structure to efficiently store and index multiple genome alignments and ancestral reconstructions. HAL files are represented in {{1}}, an open standard for storing and indexing large, compressed scientific data sets. Genomes within HAL are organized according to the phylogenetic tree that relate them: each genome is segmented into pairwise DNA alignment blocks with respect to its parent and children (if present) in the tree. Note that if the phylogeny is unknown, a star tree can be used. The modularity provided by this tree-based decomposition allows for efficient querying of sub-alignments, as well as the ability to add, remove and update genomes within the alignment with only local modifications to the structure. Another important feature of HAL is reference independence: alignments in this format can be queried with respect to the coordinates of any genome they contain.
templates.zh: HAL 是一种基于图的结构，用于高效存储与索引多个基因组比对及祖先重建结果。HAL 文件以 {{1}} 表示，这是一种用于存储与索引大型压缩科学数据集的开放标准。HAL 中的基因组按它们之间的系统发生树组织：每个基因组相对于其在树中的父节点与子节点（若有）被切分成两两 DNA 比对区块。注意若系统发生关系未知，可以使用星形树。这种基于树的分解带来的模块化，使得可以高效查询子比对，也可以在只对结构做局部修改的情况下增删与更新比对中的基因组。HAL 的另一个重要特性是参考无关：该格式的比对可以按其中任一所含基因组的坐标来查询。

templates.pat: HAL files can be created or read with a comprehensive C++ API (click {{1}} for source code and manual). templates.pat: The longrange track is a bed format-like file type. Each row contains columns that define chromosome, start position (0-based), and end position (not included), and interaction target in this format chr2:333-444,55. For examples, see the source of this format at {{1}}.

templates.pat: {{1}}{{2}} The {{3}} format is line-oriented. Each multiple alignment begins with the reference genome line and ends with a blank line. Each sequence in an alignment is on a single line, which can get quite long, but there is no length limit. Words in a line are delimited by any white space. Lines starting with # are considered to be comments. Lines starting with ## can be ignored by most programs, but contain meta-data of one form or another.

templates.pat: {{1}} The field {{2}} is a comma-separated list of the numbers with the possible values 0, 1, 2 or -1, one per exon, in order of transcription. This is different than the exonStarts and exonEnds fields - if the transcript is on the negative strand, exonFrames are in the reverse order relative than exonStarts. Put differently, it means that the first value for a transcript on the minus (-) strand is the exon on the right of the screen on the Genome Browser. A value of zero means that the first codon of the exon starts at the first nucleotide of the exon. A value of one means that the first codon starts after the first nucleotide and a value of two means that it starts after the second nucleotide. See also our {{3}}. UTRs are non-coding and their exonFrame value is -1.

templates.pat: A blue navigation bar at the top of the browser provides links to several other tools and data sources. For instance, under the "View" menu, the "DNA" link enables the user to view the raw genomic DNA sequence for the coordinate range displayed in the browser window. This DNA can encode track features via elaborate text formatting options. Other links tie the Genome Browser to the BLAT alignment tool, provide access to the underlying relational database via the Table Browser, convert coordinates across different assembly dates, and open the window at the complementary {{1}} or {{2}} annotation.
templates.zh: 浏览器顶部的蓝色导航栏提供指向其它工具与数据源的链接。例如在「View」菜单下，「DNA」链接可查看浏览器窗口中所示坐标范围对应的原始基因组 DNA 序列。该 DNA 可通过丰富的文本格式选项编码轨道特征。其它链接把基因组浏览器与 BLAT 比对工具相连，经表浏览器访问底层关系数据库，在不同组装版本之间转换坐标，以及把窗口打开到互补的 {{1}} 或 {{2}} 注释。

templates.pat: {{1}} Aligning regions (usually exons when the query is cDNA) are shown as black blocks. In dense display mode, the degree of darkness corresponds to the number of features aligning to the region or the degree of quality of the match. In pack or full display mode, the aligning regions are connected by lines representing gaps in the alignment (typically spliced-out introns), with arrowheads indicating the orientation of the alignment, pointing right if the query sequence was aligned to the forward strand of the genome and left if aligned to the reverse strand. Two parallel lines are drawn over double-sided alignment gaps, which skip over unalignable sequence in both target and query. For alignments of ESTs, the arrows may be reversed to show the apparent direction of transcription deduced from splice junction sequences. In situations where no gap lines are visible, the arrowheads are displayed on the block itself. To prevent display problems, the Genome Browser imposes an upper limit on the number of alignments that can be viewed simultaneously within the tracks image. When this limit is exceeded, the Browser displays the best several hundred alignments in a condensed display mode, then lists the number of undisplayed alignments in the last row of the track. In this situation, try zooming in to display more entries or to return the track to full display mode. For some PSL tracks, {{2}} to indicate mismatching bases and query-only gaps may be available.

templates.pat: BLAT is an alignment tool like BLAST, but it is structured differently. On DNA, BLAT works by keeping an index of an entire genome in memory. Thus, the target database of BLAT is not a set of GenBank sequences, but instead an index derived from the assembly of the entire genome. By default, the index consists of all non-overlapping 11-mers except for those heavily involved in repeats, and it uses less than a gigabyte of RAM. This smaller size means that BLAT is far more easily {{1}} than BLAST. Blat of DNA is designed to quickly find sequences of 95% and greater similarity of length 40 bases or more. It may miss more divergent or shorter sequence alignments. (The default settings and expected behavior of standalone Blat are slightly different from those on the {{2}}.)
templates.zh: BLAT 是一种类似 BLAST 的比对工具，但结构不同。在处理 DNA 时，BLAT 会在内存中保存整个基因组的索引。因此 BLAT 的目标数据库不是一组 GenBank 序列，而是由整个基因组组装派生的索引。默认情况下，索引由所有互不重叠的 11-mer 组成，重度重复的除外，占用不到 1GB 内存。体积更小意味着 BLAT 比 BLAST 更容易{{1}}。DNA 版 BLAT 旨在快速找出相似度 95% 以上、长度 40 个碱基以上的序列。它可能漏掉差异更大或更短的序列比对。（独立版 Blat 的默认设置与预期行为与 {{2}} 略有不同。）

templates.pat: Very short sequences that go over a splice site in a cDNA sequence can't be found, as they are not in the genome. qPCR primers are a typical example. For these cases, try using {{1}} and selecting a gene set as the target. In general, the In-Silico PCR tool is more sensitive and should be preferred for pairs of primers.
templates.zh: 跨过剪接位点的极短 cDNA 序列找不到，因为它们不在基因组中。qPCR 引物就是典型例子。这类情况可改用{{1}}，并把基因集选作目标。一般来说，In-Silico PCR 工具灵敏度更高，成对引物应优先使用它。

templates.pat: Often for repeat sequences, you can use the {{1}} to find the other matches, but only if the other matches are long and specific enough. You can check whether any sequence is present at a particular location by using the {{2}} if your sequence is less than 30 bp. You can work around this minimum length limitation by adding more flanking sequence to your query to make the query unique enough. If this is not possible, the only alternative is to download the executables of BLAT and the .2bit file of a genome to your own machine and use BLAT on the command line. See {{3}} for more information. When using the command line version of BLAT, you can set the repMatch option to a large value to try to improve finding matches in repetitive regions and do not use one of the default 11.ooc repeat masking files.
templates.zh: 对于重复序列，通常可以用{{1}}找出其它匹配，但前提是其它匹配足够长且足够特异。若序列短于 30 bp，可以用{{2}}检查某段序列是否出现在特定位置。也可以给查询序列加上更多侧翼序列，使其足够独特，从而绕过这个最小长度限制。若无法做到，唯一的替代方案是把 BLAT 可执行程序与基因组的 .2bit 文件下载到本机，在命令行中使用 BLAT。更多信息见{{3}}。使用命令行版 BLAT 时，可以把 repMatch 选项设得很大，以改善在重复区域的匹配效果，并且不要使用默认的 11.ooc 重复屏蔽文件。

templates.pat: When you blat or isPCR a sequence which matches a chromosome location that also has a fix or alt sequence, you will see a match on the reference chromosome (e.g. "chr1") and another match on the patch sequence (e.g. chr1_KN196472v1_fix). In most cases it is safe to ignore the patch hit, as a human genome will not contain both the reference and alternate sequence at the same time. For more information on the specific kinds of patch sequences see our {{1}} on the topic.
templates.zh: 当你对一段匹配到染色体位置、而该位置同时存在 fix 或 alt 序列的序列做 blat 或 isPCR 时，会看到参考染色体上有一个匹配（如 “chr1”），patch 序列上还有一个匹配（如 chr1_KN196472v1_fix）。多数情况下可以安全地忽略 patch 命中，因为人类基因组不会同时包含参考序列与替代序列。关于各类 patch 序列的更多说明见我们的{{1}}。

The web-based Blat is tuned permissively with a minimum cut-off score of 20, which will display most of the alignments. We advise deciding which filtering parameters make the most sense for the experiment or analysis. Often these settings will be different and more stringent than those of the web-based Blat. With that in mind, use the following settings to approximate the search results of the web-based Blat:
templates.zh: 我们几乎总是{{1}} hgBLAT/gfServer 与独立的命令行 Blat 之间存在差异。最佳匹配可以用 pslReps 与 pslCDnaFilter 工具找到。网页版 Blat 的调参较宽松，最低截止评分为 20，因此会显示大多数比对。我们建议根据实验或分析的具体情况决定哪些过滤参数最合适。这些设置往往与网页版 Blat 不同，且更严格。考虑到这一点，可用以下设置来接近网页版 Blat 的检索结果：

templates.pat: Alternatively, you can try filtering your Blat PSL output using either the {{1}} or {{2}} program available in the Genome Browser source code. For information on obtaining the source code, see our {{3}} on source code licensing and downloads.

templates.pat: The formula to find the shortest query size that will guarantee a match (if matching tiles are not marked as overused) is: 2 * {{1}} + {{2}} - 1 {{3}} For example, with {{4}} set to 5 and {{5}} set to 11, matches of query size 2 * 5 + 11 - 1 = 20 bp will be found if the query matches the target exactly.{{6}} The {{7}} parameter can range from 1 to {{8}}.{{9}} The {{10}} parameter can range from 6 to 15. For protein, the range starts lower.{{11}} For {{12}}=1 (e.g., protein), the minimum guaranteed match length is: 1 * {{13}} + {{14}} - 1{{15}} Note: There is also a "minimum lucky size" for hits. This is the smallest possible hit that BLAT can find. This minimum lucky size can be calculated using the formula: {{16}} + {{17}}. For example, if we use a {{18}} of 11 and {{19}} of 5, hits smaller than 16 bases won't be reported.
templates.zh: 保证能匹配到的最短查询长度（前提是匹配的 tile 未被标记为过度使用）的公式是：2 * {{1}} + {{2}} - 1 {{3}} 例如，当 {{4}} 设为 5、{{5}} 设为 11 时，若查询与目标完全匹配，查询长度为 2 * 5 + 11 - 1 = 20 bp 的匹配就能找到。{{6}} {{7}} 参数的取值范围是 1 到 {{8}}。{{9}} {{10}} 参数的取值范围是 6 到 15。对蛋白质而言，范围起点更低。{{11}} 对 {{12}}=1（例如蛋白质），保证的最短匹配长度是：1 * {{13}} + {{14}} - 1{{15}} 注意：命中还有一个「最小幸运长度」，即 BLAT 能找出的最小可能命中。这个最小幸运长度可用公式计算：{{16}} + {{17}}。例如，若 {{18}} 用 11、{{19}} 用 5，则小于 16 个碱基的命中不会被报告。

templates.pat: A note on filtering output: increasing the {{1}} parameter value beyond one-half of the query size has no further effect. Therefore, use either the {{2}} or {{3}} program available in the Genome Browser source code to filter for the size, score, coverage, or quality desired. For information on obtaining the source code, see our {{4}} on source code licensing and downloads.
templates.zh: 关于输出过滤的说明：把 {{1}} 参数值提高到超过查询长度的一半不会再有额外效果。因此，请用基因组浏览器源码中提供的 {{2}} 或 {{3}} 程序，按所需的大小、评分、覆盖度或质量进行过滤。获取源码的方法见我们关于源码许可与下载的{{4}}。

templates.pat: BLAT is designed to quickly find sequence similarity between query and target sequences. Generally, BLAT is used to find locations of sequence homology in a single target genome or determine the exon structure of an mRNA. BLAT also allows users to compare the query sequence against all of the default assemblies for organisms hosted on the UCSC Genome Browser. The {{1}} feature may be useful if you have an ambiguous query sequence and are trying to determine what organism it may belong to.
templates.zh: BLAT 用于快速找出查询序列与目标序列之间的相似性。通常，BLAT 用来在单个目标基因组中查找序列同源位置，或确定 mRNA 的外显子结构。BLAT 还允许用户把查询序列与 UCSC 基因组浏览器托管的全部生物默认组装进行比对。如果你的查询序列有歧义、想确定它可能属于哪个物种，{{1}} 功能会很有用。

templates.pat: Selecting the "Search ALL" checkbox above the Genome drop-down list allows you to search the genomes of the default assemblies for all of our organisms. It also searches any attached hubs' Blat servers, meaning you can search your user-generated assembly hubs. {{1}} {{2}} The new dynamic BLAT servers allow one to perform BLAT searches on an unlimited number of genomes with a fixed amount of memory, however it takes time to swap virtual pages from the storage device. Currently dynamic BLAT servers are not supported for "Search ALL", and they are noted as skipped in the output. {{3}} {{4}} The results page displays an ordered list of all our organisms and their homology with your query sequence. The results are ordered so that the organism with the best alignment score is at the top, indicating which region(s) of that organism has the greatest homology with your query sequence. The entire alignment, including mismatches and gaps, must {{5}} 20 or higher in order to appear in the Blat output. By clicking into a link in the {{6}} you will be taken to a new page displaying various locations and scores of sequence homology in the assembly of interest.
templates.zh: 勾选 Genome 下拉列表上方的「Search ALL」复选框，可以检索我们全部生物的默认组装的基因组。它还会检索所挂载 hub 的 Blat 服务器，也就是说可以检索你自建的组装 hub。{{1}} {{2}} 新的动态 BLAT 服务器允许在固定内存下对不限数量的基因组做 BLAT 检索，但从存储设备换入虚拟页需要时间。目前「Search ALL」不支持动态 BLAT 服务器，输出中会把它们标为已跳过。{{3}} {{4}} 结果页会显示我们全部生物的有序列表及其与你查询序列的同源性。排序使比对评分最好的生物排在最前，表明该生物哪些区域与你查询序列同源性最高。整个比对（包括错配与缺口）必须{{5}}达到 20 或更高，才会出现在 Blat 输出中。点击 {{6}} 中的链接，会打开新页面，显示感兴趣组装中序列同源性的各个位置与评分。

templates.pat: For example, if two 11-base tile hits align perfectly, it would result in a score of 22. This is above the minimum required score of 20 (see {{1}}), and would be reported as an alignment. However, there are penalties for gaps and mismatches, as well as potential overlap (see stepsize in {{2}}), all of which could bring the score below 20. In that case, Blat ALL would report 2 "hits", but clicking into the assembly would report no matches. This most often occurs when there are only a few (1-3) hits reported by Blat ALL.
templates.zh: 例如，若两个 11 碱基的 tile 命中完美比对，评分会是 22。这高于最低要求的 20 分（见{{1}}），会作为一条比对报告。然而缺口与错配会扣分，还可能存在重叠（见 {{2}} 中的 stepsize），这些都可能把评分降到 20 以下。此时 Blat ALL 会报告 2 个「命中」，但点进该组装却报告没有匹配。这种情况最常出现在 Blat ALL 只报告少数（1-3 个）命中时。

templates.pat: Protein-translated BLAT (protein or translated RNA queries) uses the standard vertebrate genetic code. It will be slightly less sensitive on mitochondria and species using other genetic codes. More information on standard genetic codes can be found on the {{1}}. Additional details on mitochondria codon tables can be found on the {{2}}.

templates.zh: {{1}} - 可选。告诉浏览器从哪张表获取基因读框。通常用于名字以「Frames」结尾的 N 路比对。

templates.pat: {{1}} - roughly corresponds to blast bit values (roughly 2 points per aligning base minus penalties for mismatches and inserts).
templates.zh: {{1}} - 大致对应 blast 的 bit 值（每个比对碱基约 2 分，再减去错配与插入的罚分）。

templates.pat: {{1}} -- Optional. Positive integer value. For programs that do multiple pass alignments such as blastz, this shows which pass this alignment came from. Typically, pass 1 will find the strongest alignments genome-wide, and pass 2 will find weaker alignments between two first-pass alignments.
templates.zh: {{1}} -- 可选。正整数。对于 blastz 这类做多轮比对的程序，此项表示该比对来自第几轮。通常第 1 轮找出全基因组最强的比对，第 2 轮则在两段第一轮比对之间找出较弱的比对。

templates.pat: {{1}} -- The name of one of the source sequences for the alignment. For sequences that are resident in a browser assembly, the form 'database.chromosome' allows automatic creation of links to other assemblies. Non-browser sequences are typically referenced by the species name alone.
templates.zh: {{1}} -- 比对的源序列之一的名称。对于驻留在浏览器组装中的序列，'database.chromosome' 形式会自动创建到其它组装的链接。非浏览器的序列通常只用物种名引用。

templates.pat: {{1}} -- The size of the entire source sequence, not just the parts involved in the alignment.
templates.zh: {{1}} -- 整个源序列的长度，而不只是参与比对的那些部分。

templates.pat: {{1}} -- A character that specifies the relationship between the sequence in this block and the sequence that appears in the previous block.
templates.zh: {{1}} -- 一个字符，说明本区块中的序列与上一个区块中出现的序列之间的关系。

templates.pat: {{1}} -- Usually the number of bases in the aligning species between the start of this alignment and the end of the previous one.
templates.zh: {{1}} -- 通常是对齐物种中，从本次比对开头到上一次比对结尾之间的碱基数。

templates.pat: {{1}} -- A character that specifies the relationship between the sequence in this block and the sequence that appears in the subsequent block.
templates.zh: {{1}} -- 一个字符，说明本区块中的序列与后续区块中出现的序列之间的关系。

templates.pat: {{1}} -- Usually the number of bases in the aligning species between the end of this alignment and the start of the next one.
templates.zh: {{1}} -- 通常是对齐物种中，从本次比对结尾到下一次比对开头之间的碱基数。

templates.pat: {{1}} -- there are bases between the bases in this block and the one before or after it.
templates.zh: {{1}} -- 本区块与它前一个或后一个区块之间存在碱基。

templates.pat: {{1}} -- this is the first sequence from this src chrom or scaffold but it is bridged by another alignment from a different chrom or scaffold.
templates.zh: {{1}} -- 这是来自该 src 染色体或 scaffold 的第一条序列，但它被另一条来自不同染色体或 scaffold 的比对桥接。

templates.pat: {{1}} -- the sequence in this block has been used before in a previous block (likely a tandem duplication)
templates.zh: {{1}} -- 本区块中的序列在此前的区块中已经用过（很可能是串联重复）。

templates.pat: {{1}} -- The size of the entire source sequence, not just the parts involved in the alignment; alignment and any insertions (dashes) as well.
templates.zh: {{1}} -- 整个源序列的长度，而不只是参与比对的那些部分；也包括比对本身以及所有插入（短横线）。

templates.pat: Here is a simple example of three alignment blocks derived from five starting sequences. The first {{1}} line is necessary for custom tracks, but should be removed otherwise. Repeats are shown as lowercase, and each block may have a subset of the input sequences. All sequence columns and rows must contain at least one nucleotide (no columns or rows that contain only insertions).
templates.zh: 这是一个由五条起始序列得到三个比对区块的简单示例。第一行 {{1}} 行对自定义轨道是必需的，其它情况下应当删掉。重复序列以小写表示，每个区块可以只含输入序列的一个子集。所有序列的列与行都必须至少含一个核苷酸（不能有只含插入的列或行）。

templates.pat: The datasets for the built-in microarray tracks in the Genome Browser are stored in BED15 format, an extension of {{1}} format that includes three additional fields: expCount, expIds, and expScores. To display correctly in the Genome Browser, microarray tracks require the setting of several attributes in the trackDb file associated with the track's genome assembly. Each microarray track set must also have an associated microarrayGroups.ra configuration file that contains additional information about the data in each of the arrays.
templates.zh: 基因组浏览器内置的微阵列轨道，其数据以 BED15 格式保存，这是 {{1}} 格式的扩展，多出三个字段：expCount、expIds 和 expScores。要在基因组浏览器中正确显示，微阵列轨道需要在与该轨道所在基因组组装关联的 trackDb 文件中设置若干属性。每个微阵列轨道集还必须有一个关联的 microarrayGroups.ra 配置文件，其中包含各阵列中数据的附加信息。

templates.pat: {{1}} - the number 0x1A412743 in the architecture of the machine that created the file
templates.zh: {{1}} - 创建该文件的机器架构下的数值 0x1A412743

templates.pat: {{1}} - the 32-bit offset of the sequence data relative to the start of the file, not aligned to any 4-byte padding boundary
templates.zh: {{1}} - 序列数据相对于文件起始位置的 32 位偏移量，不按任何 4 字节填充边界对齐

templates.pat: {{1}} - an array of length nBlockCount of 32 bit integers indicating the (0-based) starting position of a block of Ns
templates.zh: {{1}} - 长度为 nBlockCount 的 32 位整数数组，给出每个 N 区块的（0 起始）起始位置

templates.pat: {{1}} - an array of length nBlockCount of 32 bit integers indicating the length of a block of Ns
templates.zh: {{1}} - 长度为 nBlockCount 的 32 位整数数组，给出每个 N 区块的长度

templates.pat: {{1}} - an array of length maskBlockCount of 32 bit integers indicating the (0-based) starting position of a masked block
templates.zh: {{1}} - 长度为 maskBlockCount 的 32 位整数数组，给出每个被屏蔽区块的（0 起始）起始位置

templates.pat: {{1}} - an array of length maskBlockCount of 32 bit integers indicating the length of a masked block
templates.zh: {{1}} - 长度为 maskBlockCount 的 32 位整数数组，给出每个被屏蔽区块的长度

templates.pat: {{1}} - the DNA packed to two bits per base, represented as so: T - 00, C - 01, A - 10, G - 11. The first base is in the most significant 2-bit byte; the last base is in the least significant 2 bits. For example, the sequence TCAG is represented as 00011011.
templates.zh: {{1}} - 以每碱基两位打包的 DNA，表示方式为：T - 00，C - 01，A - 10，G - 11。第一个碱基位于最高有效 2 位字节，最后一个碱基位于最低有效 2 位。例如序列 TCAG 表示为 00011011。

templates.pat: {{1}} - A comma-separated list of the frequency of each allele, given in the same order as the name field. If unknown, a list of zeroes (matching the alleleCount) should be used.
templates.zh: {{1}} - 以逗号分隔的各等位基因频率列表，顺序与 name 字段一致。若未知，应使用与 alleleCount 数量一致的零值列表。

templates.pat: {{1}} - A comma-separated list of the quality score of each allele, given in the same order as the name field. If unknown, a list of zeroes (matching the alleleCount) should be used.
templates.zh: {{1}} - 以逗号分隔的各等位基因质量分列表，顺序与 name 字段一致。若未知，应使用与 alleleCount 数量一致的零值列表。

templates.pat: {{1}} - Measurement of statistical significance (-log10). Use -1 if no pValue is assigned.
templates.zh: {{1}} - 统计显著性的度量（-log10）。若未指派 pValue，使用 -1。

templates.pat: {{1}} - Measurement of statistical significance using false discovery rate (-log10). Use -1 if no qValue is assigned.
templates.zh: {{1}} - 用错误发现率衡量的统计显著性（-log10）。若未指派 qValue，使用 -1。

templates.pat: {{1}} - Point-source called for this peak; 0-based offset from chromStart. Use -1 if no point-source called.
templates.zh: {{1}} - 为该峰判定的点源；相对于 chromStart 的 0 起始偏移。若未判定点源，使用 -1。

templates.pat: {{1}} - The ending position of the feature in the chromosome or scaffold.
templates.zh: {{1}} - 特征在染色体或 scaffold 上的结束位置。

templates.pat: {{1}} - The starting position of the feature in the chromosome or scaffold.
templates.zh: {{1}} - 特征在染色体或 scaffold 上的起始位置。
